all.text: After the terrible retribution visited upon Lat-Nam, the School of the Unseen chooses to hide from the eyes of the world.
Jaya fails to steal from Jodah's chambers, but sensing her magic he lets her study at the school.

Jaya brings Jodah Lim-Dûl's hand with the ring finger missing, and at Soldev she, as the vessel of Mairsil, stabs Jodah, and the Adnates use his blood to activate the War Beasts, which level Soldev and the school.
Jaya's planeswalker spark flares and she erases Mairsil's presence and destroys the war beasts, then helps seal the pit and relocate the school.
